findings.description: Response.__init__ now reads self.raw.reason, but self.raw is None on a freshly constructed Response, and the adapter sets raw and reason only after construction. This raises AttributeError.
findings.rationale: Trigger: any call to Response(), e.g. in adapters.build_response or by users and tests. Mechanism: self.raw is initialized to None in __init__, so accessing .reason on None fails. Impact: constructing any Response crashes, breaking essentially all requests.
